Name: Deep Loot Framework
Author: Larvuk
Description:
[b][size=5]Players:[/size][/b]

This mod does nothing on its own. Download it if it is required by another mod you're using.


[size=5][b]Modders:[/b][/size]

DLF let you define additional loots to monsters depending on their depth in the Skull Cavern.
For example, the sword you added in your mod could be dropped by ghosts at floors 100+.

You can set the min and max floors, the related monsters, the chances to drop the item, the min and max amounts dropped.

[b][size=4]How to use DLF[/size][/b]

Once DLF is installed, all configuration is done inside CP.
Inside of your item entry, add the DLF CustomFields you need as I did in the following example:

[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Objects",
"Entries": {
"OneSeasonAtATime.energycell": {
"Name": "OneSeasonAtATime.energycell",
"Type": "Basic",
"Category": -15,
"DisplayName": "Energy cell",
"Description": "Load it in your Greenhouse Controller to make it work longer.",
"Texture": "Mods/{{ModId}}/energycell",
"CustomFields": {
"larvuk.DLF/MonsterId.1": "Royal Serpent",
"larvuk.DLF/MinFloor.1": "15",
"larvuk.DLF/MaxNumber.1": "2",
"larvuk.DLF/Chances.1": "10",
}
}
}
},[/code]
This configuration will add a 1% chance to drop 1-2 energy cells when killing Royal Serpents on floors 15+ of the Skull Cavern.
The possible fields are the following:

[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/MonsterId.X"[/font]: the ID of the monster that will drop the item. Mandatory. See the Monsters.json file in the SDV game code: the keys are the monsters' IDs.
[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/MinFloor.X"[/font]: the number of the shallowest floor where the drop might trigger. Default 1.
[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/MaxFloor.X"[/font]: the number of the deepest floor where the drop might trigger. Default -1 (no limit).
[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/Chances.X"[/font]: The chance (out of 1000) for a monster to drop an item. For example, "100" means 10%. Default 1000 (100%).
[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/MinNumber.X"[/font]: The minimum stack that will be dropped. Default 1.
[font=Courier New]"larvuk.DLF/MaxNumber.X"[/font]: The maximum stack that will be dropped. Default 1.

X represents an arbitrary (but mandatory) value identifying the rules that will work together. That means if you're adding the same item as a drop to different monsters (or different depths with different chances, or whatever) you'll add all the rules to the same CustomFields, but with different values of X.


[size=5][b]Behind the scene:[/b][/size]

Made without any trace of AI.
DLF uses Harmony, and could have compatibility issues with other mods modifying the same method: [b][font=Courier New]Monster.InitializeForLocation[/font][/b] (postfix).
[url=https://github.com/Larvuk/DeepLootFramework/tree/master/DeepLootFramework]Source code is here[/url].
